html:
SMTO-MEM-0031 — Your Knowledge storage is full

GUID: e5ae1ed7-6bfc-53c4-b233-b550e3c1108c
Slug: knowledge-knowledge-storage-quota-exceeded
Domain: MEM · Subsystem: knowledge

What happened

  • Your Knowledge files have used up the storage space allowed for your account, so this new file wasn't saved. Files already in Knowledge are unchanged.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open Knowledge and look at the status line near the top. When Knowledge is ready, it shows how many MB of source files you have stored. This tells you how close you are to your storage limit.
  2. Go through your collections and conversations. For each document you no longer need, open Manage on its card and select Delete. Deleting a document removes its file and frees space. Only delete documents you are sure you don't need; deleting can't be undone.
  3. If you need everything you have, ask the person who manages SMTO to raise Storage limit per user (bytes). It is under Administrator resource limits on the Document settings tab in Knowledge. Only an administrator can change how much space each account is allowed.
  4. Upload the file again with Upload documents. Once enough space is free, the same file can be saved.

What success looks like

  • The file appears in the document list and moves to Ready to search.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them, with the size of the file you tried to add, to the person who manages SMTO. Don't delete documents you still need just to make room.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • RagStore.save_asset refused to store the file because the account's stored Knowledge files plus this file would exceed the installation's user_storage_bytes limit.

What this means

  • This account has reached its allotted space for Knowledge source files. The original operation and completed work retain their own recorded outcomes; this diagnostic does not replay them.

Why this can happen

  • The component reported knowledge_storage_quota_exceeded. This does not establish the outcome of unrelated operations.

How to diagnose it

  • Enough account storage is available for the upload.
  • Inspect the error reference and the affected component’s current observation before selecting a recovery action.

How to fix it

  • Compare the account's stored Knowledge bytes (shown as MB of source files on the Knowledge page) with the installation limit user_storage_bytes under Administrator resource limits. Free space by deleting unneeded documents, or have an administrator raise “Storage limit per user (bytes)”; the rejected file was removed and not recorded.
  • Review your source files in Knowledge. Remove only files you no longer need, or ask an administrator to increase your Knowledge storage limit.

Retry and execution caution

  • Enough account storage is available for the upload.

How to verify the fix

  • Enough account storage is available for the upload.

What not to do

  • Do not delete retained task data or repeat an operation with an unknown outcome.

Technical notes

  • Status checks do not replay tasks or modify source documents.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
